scope.summary: Lock the ADR-0517/ADR-0520/ADR-0521 WorkAreaTree W1 consumer seam with content-addressed work-area and node identity vocabulary, leaving parser implementation to W2.
explicit_non_claims: No Rust, Markdown, or other language parser implementation is introduced.
No AST rewrite, doc-tracking, affected-set computation, SCM implementation, or buck2/RBE integration is introduced.
The crate is dependency-free; it only publishes stable trait and value vocabulary.

hyperscaler_lens.north_star: One owned AST substrate feeds work-area locking, gates, remediation, documentation tracking, affected-set computation, SCM identity, build cache identity, and CD artifact identity.
hyperscaler_lens.scale_property: Consumers bind to WorkAreaTree and content-addressed WorkAreaNodeId rather than parser internals, allowing the W2 parser and W4 bespoke SCM to swap in behind a stable no-single-leader-friendly interface.

facets.F1_correctness: WorkAreaHash and NodeContentHash are fixed-size SHA-256 content addresses; WorkAreaNodeId combines whole-work-area hash, node content hash, and source locator so consumers can distinguish duplicate node content by location.
facets.F2_tests: RED observed before implementation: cargo test -p oya-work-area-tree-kernel --test work_area_tree_contract failed because src/lib.rs was absent. GREEN: cargo test -p oya-work-area-tree-kernel passed 6 tests.
facets.F3_maintainability: The crate is pure Rust/std with private fields, constructors, accessors, data_class annotations, and no parser-specific coupling.
facets.F4_compatibility: No existing call-sites are changed; the root Cargo workspace picks up the crate through the existing libs/oya-* glob.
facets.F5_security: unsafe_code is forbidden; no IO, shell, credentials, network, or external dependencies are introduced.
facets.F6_privacy: All fields are INTERNAL_ONLY structural metadata; no tenant or personal data processing is introduced.
facets.F7_operability: The registry catalog row marks the crate preview/unreviewed and names explicit non-claims for future W2/W4 implementers.
facets.F8_performance: The interface is clone/value based for a skeleton contract; no runtime parser or traversal engine is introduced.
facets.F9_compliance: Traceability cites ADR-0517, ADR-0520, and ADR-0521; MISTAKES-LEDGER search found no prior WorkAreaTree/work-area/content-address node identity row.
facets.F10_reversibility: The change is isolated to one new kernel crate, its contract tests, a catalog row, and this evidence packet.
facets.F11_observability: Evidence records commands and non-claims; future implementation work can reference this interface-lock packet.
facets.F13_migration: Supports W2 parser landing behind WorkAreaTree and W4 bespoke SCM work-area identity without reworking consumer-facing vocabulary.
